episode_summary: In this episode, Kim Rittberg discusses the importance of integrating personal content with professional posts to enhance social media engagement. She emphasizes the use of video content, both short and long form, to build credibility and connect with audiences. Kim also highlights the value of sharing client success stories to establish trust and credibility with potential clients.
